name: The sandbox, in sequence
title: The sandbox, in sequence
story: A sequence diagram whose lanes appear as they are first used: a person, the factory, the pod with the agent, the model gateway, the model API and the repository. Rows draw one at a time, each lit while its caption speaks and muted after: the factory starts a throwaway pod (gVisor, non-root, read-only root, no service account token); the probe's tries at the internet, the host and the metadata address stop at a cross while a named host is open; a model call goes to the gateway, held at its worst case, sent with the gateway's key and booked at its real cost; the pod holds a one-hour gateway identity and never a push token or model key; at the cap the gateway refuses, the factory asks the person, who funds it; at the end the factory kills the agent's processes, mints a write token, pushes once, revokes it and deletes the pod. The picture holds one second and fades out.
